manifesto.quote: Hong Kong SMEs are not short of tools. They are short of tools that speak the same language.
manifesto.body: So LegionOne was built as one system from day one — quotation, order, invoice, payment, inventory and customers all run on the same data, so every department is reading the same numbers.

pains.label: Six daily pains
pains.headline: The same working day. A completely different outcome.
pains.lead: Six problems Hong Kong owners hit every day — and what they look like once LegionOne is in place.

rows.title: Tools scattered everywhere
rows.pain: Excel, WhatsApp, the banking app and the CRM each keep their own version. Nothing ever matches.
rows.solution: Quotations, orders, invoices and payments share one source of truth. Nobody reconciles by hand.

rows.title: Customers go quiet
rows.pain: Client records are scattered across four colleagues' personal WhatsApp lists.
rows.solution: A 360° customer record: contact history, quotations and invoices, one search away.

rows.title: Month-end is a sprint
rows.pain: Reconciliation takes three days and the margin figure is always an approximation.
rows.solution: Live AR and AP ageing and live gross margin. Month-end finishes inside a day.

rows.title: Out of reach while travelling
rows.pain: The boss is on a trip and finance, orders and stock are all out of contact.
rows.solution: Cloud sync across phone, tablet and desktop, so approvals happen wherever you are.

rows.title: Collections get missed
rows.pain: Overdue invoices sit there and someone has to chase each customer by WhatsApp.
rows.solution: AR ageing reports trigger the collection list automatically, and follow-up rates improve within seven days.

rows.title: Reports arrive late
rows.pain: Weekly and monthly reports are hand-built in Excel, so the boss is always reading last week's numbers.
rows.solution: The dashboard refreshes live: today's sales and every outstanding receivable, in one view.

day.label: One working day
day.headline: Five decisions a day that used to need reconciling.
day.lead: The same hours, done differently, end very differently. This is how a trading SME moves from quotation to reconciliation on LegionOne.

steps.title: Quotation — one version is enough
steps.desc: The customer wants goods, so costs, tax and lead time are pulled together inside the system before a single quotation goes out. Revise it as often as you like; it is still the same version.

steps.title: Order — one action, four updates
steps.desc: Once the customer confirms, the quotation becomes an order. Stock is decremented, a purchase order is raised and the follow-up is written onto the customer record — at the same time.

steps.title: Invoice — ageing updates instantly
steps.desc: Invoices are raised from the order and AR and AP ageing refresh straight away, so you know which payment is outstanding without waiting for month-end.

steps.title: Payment — collections queue themselves
steps.desc: Ageing reports build the collection list for you and the cash-flow forecast updates in step, so nobody has to message each customer by hand.

steps.title: Reconciliation — differences itemised
steps.desc: The bank statement is imported, accounts match automatically, and each difference is flagged. Month-end is no longer a cell-by-cell check of an Excel sheet.

methodology.headline: We will not make you start from zero, and we will not make you work around the system.
methodology.lead: Going live is not a matter of swapping one piece of software for another. We work in three steps, and each one starts by looking at how you operate today.

steps.title: Map what you have
steps.desc: We start with the tools and the processes you already run, so we can see exactly where the duplication is and where the numbers disagree.

steps.title: Match a template
steps.desc: We begin from an industry template, so you are not assembling modules from nothing — each one is checked against how your business really works.

steps.title: Go live and tune
steps.desc: We adjust the flows and the reports against how you actually operate. The system has to fit you, not the other way round.

story.title: Our story
story.body: LegionOne was founded by Hong Kong SME owners and a technical team who had lived through it — the quotation revised eight times, the month-end Excel reconciliation that ran past midnight. Today we package that hard-won know-how into one platform, so more Hong Kong owners can spend their time on the things that actually matter: customers and product.
